## User Story

**As a** Jarvis user  
**I want** filesystem tools  
**So that** the agent can read and write project files safely

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `read_file(path)` tool
- [ ] `write_file(path, content)` tool
- [ ] `list_directory(path)` tool
- [ ] Tools registered in global registry
- [ ] Safety checks prevent writes to system directories

## Story Points

**Estimate:** 3

Sprint 1
